summary: Cybin Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 3, 2026, disclosing via Exhibit 99.1 the appointment of Michael Halstead as CEO of Helus Pharma, its subsidiary and reporting issuer. Halstead, former President of Intra-Cellular Therapies, succeeds effective immediately, bringing experience from the US$14.6 billion sale to Johnson & Johnson. The appointment is tied to upcoming Phase 3 topline data for HLP003 expected in Q4 2026. The filing is a routine CEO transition announcement, not a forced departure; no financial terms or board advisors are disclosed.
